INSERT INTO api_monitor_record (id, api_url, http_method, elapsed_ms, status_code, trace_id, app_name, server_ip, request_time, sharding_date) VALUES
(#{item.id}, #{item.apiUrl}, #{item.httpMethod}, #{item.elapsedMs}, #{item.statusCode}, #{item.traceId}, #{item.appName}, #{item.serverIp}, #{item.requestTime}, #{item.shardingDate})

INSERT INTO api_monitor_metrics (api_url, app_name, time_window, request_count, avg_ms, max_ms, min_ms, sharding_date) SELECT r.api_url, r.app_name, DATE_FORMAT(r.request_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00') AS time_window, COUNT(*) AS request_count, ROUND(AVG(r.elapsed_ms), 2) AS avg_ms, MAX(r.elapsed_ms) AS max_ms, MIN(r.elapsed_ms) AS min_ms, DATE(r.request_time) AS sharding_date FROM api_monitor_record r LEFT JOIN api_monitor_metrics m ON m.api_url = r.api_url AND m.app_name = r.app_name AND m.time_window = DATE_FORMAT(r.request_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:00') WHERE m.id IS NULL AND r.request_time >= #{startTime} AND r.request_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY r.api_url, r.app_name, time_window, sharding_date
